sentences.text:
Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.6494 Of 2024
Order:

(ORAL) This writ petition is filed aggrieved by the action of respondent Nos.2 to 5 in failing to disclose the status of Crime No.1222 of 2007 dated 13.12.2007 registered against the petitioner and showing the same as if it is pending despite issuing proceedings No.167/MK- 3/RCK/2021 dated 17.08.2021 by respondent No.4 for closure of the rowdy sheet opened against the petitioner, as illegal and unconstitutional.

2. Mr. R. Laxmikanth Reddy, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, produced written instructions and submitted that Crime No.1222 of 2007 of Uppal Police Station was registered under Sections 420, 468 and 471 IPC on 13.12.2007 based on a private complaint filed by Mr. B.
Anjaiah, s/o. Lingaiah, against the petitioner herein.
It is a Court referred case.
The petitioner is Accused No.1 and B. Ramesh is Accused No.2.
In the said case, petitioner-Accused No.1 surrendered before the Honourable Court on 02.02.2008 and was enlarged on bail.

After completion of investigation, charge sheet was filed before the III Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad, and the case ended in acquittal on 27.02.2013 vide CC.No.316 of 2008 (re- registered on transfer) on the file of Principal Junior Civil Judge-cum- Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal Malkajgiri District.

entities.text: Principal Junior Civil Judge-cum- Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal Malkajgiri District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. In view of the above, no further orders are required to be passed.

However, respondent No.2 is directed is consider the request of the petitioner for closure of rowdy sheet opened against him taking into account the acquittal recorded against him in CC.No.316 of 2008 on the file of Principal Junior Civil Judge-cum-Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal Malkajgiri District, arising out of Crime No.1222 of 2007 of Uppal Police Station, and pass orders within a period of four (04)
weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4.

entities.text: Principal Junior Civil Judge-cum-Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal Malkajgiri District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in the writ petition stand closed.
